title: Bolden: not known to Laine at first, then 'I knew him'
summary: Laine says he never heard of Bolden in the 1880s but then says he knew him and heard him play.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles

blocks.x: No. No, at that time, no, now. If he did, I never heard of him.
